title: Lemo Clip Input
description: The input clip.json written by `lemo_render new` and authored per clip. It is the source of truth `lemo_render validate` reads: the style, the format, the named inputs and the facts. It is distinct from the pipeline artifact schemas/artifacts/lemo_clip.schema.json, which records the built clip workspace.

clip_id.description: Folder name of the clip, unique within the run.

style_id.description: One of the fifteen lemo style ids.

subject.description: What the clip is about, in a phrase.

one_idea.description: The single idea the clip must land.

aspect.description: Frame aspect, restricted to the style's supported set.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length in seconds, inside the style's native window.

sound.description: Audio intent. v1 is silent, so this is normally "none".

text_mode.description: How on-screen text is handled for this clip (for example title-only or burned-in subtitles).

inputs.description: Maps each required input name from the style manifest (data, cutouts, ui_spec, parts_spec) to a path relative to the clip folder.

additionalProperties.description: Path relative to the clip directory; must stay inside it.

facts.description: The real, checkable claims shown in the clip. Empty when the style needs none.
